salesPlays.name: Build and Run Applications
salesPlays.description: The Build & Run sales play is a guide for positioning Red Hat as the trusted, open hybrid platform that enables modernize legacy applications, build new cloud-native apps faster and improve developer productivity - while reducing costs, increasing agility and maintaining security.

salesPlays.name: IT Operations Efficiency
salesPlays.description: The IT Operations Efficiency sales play is a guide for positioning Red Hat as the trusted, open hybrid platform that helps customers simplify deployments, expand automation and unify day-2 operations—reducing cost, minimizing risk and freeing IT teams to focus on innovation across datacenter, cloud and edge.

salesPlays.name: Modernize Infrastructure
salesPlays.description: The Modernize Infrastructure sales play is a guide for positioning Red Hat as the trusted, open hybrid platform for organizations to standardize, secure and modernize their legacy infrastructure - reducing operational complexity and cost, and build secured, scalable foundation for future innovation across hybrid environments.

tdps.name: Automation
tdps.description: The Automation Technical Decision Point (TDP) positions Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform as the mission-critical foundation for modernizing IT, using a unified governance framework to consolidate fragmented tools and deliver measurable outcomes like 68% faster deployments and reduced downtime.

tdps.name: AI Platform
tdps.description: The AI Platform Technology Decision Point positions Red Hat as the trusted open platform for building, deploying, and scaling AI/ML workloads. Covers model training and serving with OpenShift AI, single-server inference with RHEL AI and InstructLab, enterprise-grade agentic AI deployments, and AI Factory with NVIDIA.

tdps.name: App Platform
tdps.description: The Application Platform Technology Decision Point positions Red Hat OpenShift as the enterprise Kubernetes platform with built-in CI/CD, security, and developer tooling. Covers cloud-native application development and platform engineering.

tdps.name: Container Mgmt
